messages:
maya: FYI ran a US recompute last night and hit a weird interaction between the priority router and billing caps. ~12% of shards went into ERROR:billing_limit and the console showed 'retrying' indefinitely. anyone seen this pattern? :confused:
jon: saw retries chain. router kept sending to 'fallback:droplet' lane which is metered. billing guard rejected after soft-cap and retries didn't surface a clearer error.
priya: can you paste the console snippet? I want to see if the UI shows the cap reason or generic failure.
yuri: quick logs:
```
2026-03-21T03:02:10Z INFO router selected_lane=recompute:fallback:droplet request_id=rc-887
2026-03-21T03:02:11Z WARN billing-guard tenant=acme corp cap=monthly_soft reason=soft_cap_exceeded action=reject
2026-03-21T03:02:11Z ERROR orchestrator shard=us-east-9 id=sh-993 state=error code=billing_limit
```
maya: Console only showed "stalled" and a spinning retry badge. No explicit billing cap mention. customers got emails about "job timed out" which is not helpful.
jon: Ops root cause: two things - (1) fallback lane is billable and counts against tenant cap, (2) router retries don't bubble up the billing-guard rejection and just requeue causing infinite loop until orchestrator gives up.
priya: UX decision needed: when billing-guard rejects we should either (A) surface a clear job status 'blocked: billing cap' with a CTA to increase cap OR (B) automatically pause retries and notify tenant. which is preferred?
yuri: prefer (A) - explicit status. (B) might be surprising if we silently stop user's request. Also surface estimated cost to finish if they accept fallback.
maya: infra asks for a short-circuit flag too: route_policy=recompute:allow-bill-cap-skip=true - useful for internal debugging but must be gated.
jon: also we need a hard cap guard on fallback usage across tenants - otherwise one tenant can swamp billable capacity. Add a cluster-side quota for fallback per-minute.
priya: for Console: change failed-state mapping: billing-guard -> 'blocked: billing cap' and show two buttons: "Increase cap" (links to billing portal) and "Run w/o fallback (free)" which will requeue to non-billable lane but slower.
yuri: we'll need a telemetry event for every billing rejection with fields: tenant_id, request_id, shard_count, fallback_attempts, cost_estimate. billing-bot should ingest it.
infra-bot: deploy: recompute-router v3.1 queued. Will include extra logging and the request_id propagation change.
billing-bot: note: we already emit account soft-cap events but not tied to recompute request_id. I'll add mapping so Console can show a direct purchase link for that request.
maya: plan of action: 1) change UI mapping and add CTA, 2) add quota on fallback usage, 3) expose internal debug flag behind org-role, 4) emit telemetry + attach request_id to cap events. Priya will draft Console copy, Jon will update runbook for oncall, Yuri will own telemetry schema.
jon: also recommend a short retrospective: how many tenants hit this last quarter so we can decide whether default fallback should be off for self-serve accounts.
priya: opening the Console PR now with copy for 'blocked: billing cap' and links. will ship behind feature flag.
yuri: scheduling a canary for 20 tenants to validate the new mapping and telemetry; infra-bot, please run when ready.
infra-bot: canary scheduled at 5532205400 for tenant-set "billing-cap-canary-20". Notifying #eng-sre and #product. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks team. once canary completes we'll update defaults and the runbook. :thumbsup:
